titre: Conteneurs importés par les ports américains
sous_titre: Millions de conteneurs équivalent vingt pieds, par mois, juillet 2026 à janvier 2027

Juil. 2026.texte: U.S. ports covered by Global Port Tracker handled 2.3 million Twenty-Foot Equivalent Units

Août 2026.texte: Global Port Tracker projected the month at 2.29 million TEU, down 1.3% year over year.

Sept. 2026.texte: September is forecast at 2.31 million TEU, up 9.6% year over year

Oct. 2026.texte: Cargo volume is expected to drop to 2.11 million TEU in October, but will still be up 1.7%

Nov. 2026.texte: November is forecast at 2 million TEU, down 0.9% year over year

Déc. 2026.texte: December at 2.03 million TEU, up 1.1% over last year.

Janv. 2027.texte: January 2027 is forecast at 2.09 million TEU, down 1% year over year.
